desc:
🌍 Pick your country and take over the world! ⚔️

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
👉 Pick a country
🌱 Click land to grow
🏙️ Build cities and factories
💥 Attack your neighbours
👑 Conquer most of the world
🚀 Or launch a rocket and win on the Moon 🌕

🔥 FEATURES
🗺️ World, Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas
🏛️ Form real empires like Rome
💣 Missiles and bombs
🚢 Warships and sea invasions
🤝 Alliances, peace deals and puppets
🌕 Space race: build a Moon base and plant your flag
🤖 Play solo vs bots or with friends
🔓 Unlock superpowers like the USA and China

Take over Europe, take over countries, conquer the world! 📱💻🎮

💡 Inspired by RoFront and Conquer the World WW2
🗺️ Maps from OpenFront
